UPDATE (recorded before publication)
Shortly after we recorded this video, Coforge entered a boardroom
controversy. Chairman O P Bhatt, the former SBI chief, resigned on
8 September after a KPMG internal audit raised concerns over how a
board evaluation exercise was handled. Per the company's disclosures,
the audit found that evaluation reports from an external survey
agency went only to Bhatt and to Nomination and Remuneration
Committee chairperson D K Singh, and were not circulated to the rest
